decision: Retain historically allowed rollout_cluster aborted and rollback_failed values as explicit terminal readers. No database value is removed, and no new writer transition is introduced. Aborted is unavailable/skipped; rollback_failed is unavailable/failed. Both reject resumption, preserve idempotent observations and cannot become successful.
limits: Only historical domain/read-state mismatch slice; categorical authority, paired generation, exhaustive browser trust boundaries and complete W06 qualification remain in progress.
No migration is required because the existing database constraint already allows both states. No live data or rollout was mutated.
